title: SarkarSaathiQuestionCandidateIntake
description: Validation schema for controlled discovery, search-console query intake, and manual candidate research for SarkarSaathi Question Intelligence (Phase 7). Passing this schema DOES NOT grant publication.

candidate_id.description: Unique, deterministic intake identifier (e.g. CAND-GSC-001, CAND-MAN-002, CAND-GOV-003).

original_question_wording.description: Original query or raw question phrasing observed from user search, GSC query export, or circular.

proposed_canonical_intent.description: Standardized canonical question expressing the core underlying statutory/procedural inquiry.

category.description: Primary taxonomy category matching SarkarSaathi core structure.

subcategory.description: Specific scheme, department, statutory instrument, or topic name.

discovery_source.description: Provenance channel where this candidate was discovered.

discovery_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the query or candidate was captured.

source_url.description: Verifiable HTTP/HTTPS URL of the authoritative statutory/departmental document or portal.

source_type.description: Evidence hierarchy tier of the supporting document.

supporting_evidence_excerpt.description: Direct factual excerpt or clause from the cited government document/portal answering or confirming the inquiry.

existing_related_question_id.description: Optional ID of an already published canonical question if this candidate represents an alternate phrasing or nuance.

proposed_language.description: Language in which the inquiry was formulated.

alternate_phrasings.description: Optional alternative query terms or colloquial variants observed for this canonical intent.

review_status.description: Workflow review stage. Note: Candidates can NEVER be marked VERIFIED or published in the intake stage.

reviewer_notes.description: Editorial triage notes, deduplication rationale, or evidence verification observations.
